sources.title: Run Qwen3.8-27B on Ollama: One Command, Four Quants, Free
sources.snippet: Run it with one command: ollama run qwen3.8:27b. That is the whole answer to the question this page is about. Qwen3.8 27B — Ali baba's dense 27-billion-parameter model, weights released August 14, 2026 under Apache 2.0 — went live in the Ollama library this week, and the default build is already a sensible 18 GB Q4_K_M quant (17 GB of weights plus a 931 MB vision encoder). sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.8 Locally: 27B on 16-24GB GPUs (2026)
sources.snippet: What are you actually running? Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model: text, images, and video (including hour-scale video) in one checkpoint, Apache-2.0 licensed. Native context is 262,144 tokens — the "extensible up to 1,000,000" line on the card refers to a Qwen Cloud hosted feature that is "coming soon", so plan around 256K locally.
